job.question: Which retirement system's investment consultant RFP requires firms to certify that they currently provide investment consulting services to clients whose combined assets total at least $50 billion?
job.expected_facts: Teachers' Retirement System of the State of Illinois (TRS Illinois), in its FY23 investment consultant RFP (Appendix B, Statement of Minimum Qualifications).
job.acceptance: TRS Illinois / Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois is sufficient; FY23 and appendix identifier are optional.

reviews.reason: This is an Orange County Employees Retirement System RFP, not a TRS Illinois RFP. Its minimum qualifications do not require certification that the firm currently serves clients with combined assets of at least $50 billion. The $50 billion figure appears only as a client-size category in a questionnaire.
quotes: Requests for Proposal Issued August 2021 Orange County Employees Retirement System (OCERS)
Respondent must have at least five (5) defined benefit pension plan clients, of which two (2) are public pension plans with total plan assets of at least $15 billion each.
